recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, where most of the face is obscured by deep shadow, accented by warm bokeh lights and glowing script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm bokeh circles balancing the sharp facial profile
Horizontal alignment of text across the mid-section
Texture contrast between the woven hat and soft skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered but vertically cropped, with the face occupying the lower-middle right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated lower face and the glowing text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the glowing text on the left, across the bridge of the nose, to the secondary text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper right and lower left corners.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and peach (highlights and skin)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Glowing white-yellow (text glow) and muted red (graphic element)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the lit areas.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and blacks

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' with a long, thin crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A larger, glowing script on the left paired with a smaller, cleaner script on the right for balance.
graphicDevices: Halftone dot pattern gradient on the right

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, thin-stroke handwriting feel.
Provides a similar energetic, brush-like script quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man in a cowboy hat with heavy chiaroscuro lighting. Only the nose, mouth, and chin should be visible. Add warm, out-of-focus bokeh lights on the left side. Apply a heavy film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a thin, glowing yellow-white script text on the left mid-section. Add a smaller script on the right mid-section, preceded by a subtle red halftone gradient bar.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting dramatic enough to hide the eyes?
Does the text have a visible outer glow?
Is the grain texture consistent across the image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Unique script lettering to avoid trademarked fonts
Specific placement of the red halftone bar
postGenerationChecks: Verify script is lowercase and monolinear
Ensure bokeh does not distract from the profile
Confirm film grain is visible in dark areas
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Warm Bokeh + Glowing Script Overlay + Film Grain Texture
